description: Phnom Penh (Cambodia) - Land Use/Land Cover Maps (ESA EO4SD-Urban) is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Policies and plans", published or maintained by World Bank Group. Land Use / Land Cover (LULC) information product over Phnom Penh (Cambodia) contains spatial explicit information about the different land covers / uses for current (2017) and past (2003) dates. The level of detail for the classification scheme mainly relies on the input data sources. Coverage: Cambodia. It has 12 files in ZIP, VECTOR API, PDF. The portal files it under Policies and plans. The portal gives 2020 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
